# Daily Briefing — Monday 27 October

Yesterday was a decent active rest day — 8,402 steps keeps the legs ticking over without adding load, and burning 2,761 kcal gives you solid room to stay in your calorie deficit. No session recorded is absolutely fine. The concern is that 5.1 hours of sleep; that's noticeably short and your body will have felt it.

Your HRV at 82ms is sitting below your 98-120ms baseline, which almost certainly reflects that poor sleep rather than accumulated training fatigue. Your resting HR of 55 bpm looks healthy though, and stress at 37/100 is reassuringly low. If you have an easy run planned today, go ahead — keep it genuinely easy. Avoid anything intense until that HRV recovers.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything else. Aim for 7-8 hours — it's your most powerful recovery tool and it costs nothing. Hit your 175g protein today to protect muscle while you're in that deficit.
